scope: P1/P2 source implementation and GPU execution/experiment preparation
limits: MuJoCo 3.2.7 dynamics and native sensor plugins are CPU; CUDA is required for estimator/numeric acceptance and NVIDIA EGL for P1 rendering.
Python audit read guards and separate processes prevent accidental data leakage in trusted code, not malicious native-code access.
Contact regions use known hand geometry and finite angular samples; exact object contact points/normals never enter estimator input.
Local mesh refinement preserves prior topology; it is not a full arbitrary-topology SDF.
Information covariance is uncalibrated; null directions are unbounded. Effective compliance is not a material modulus.
No successful grasp, E2 control improvement or complete VideoManip reproduction is claimed.
